jobs.description:
As a Special Client Situations Desk (SCSD) Client Account Manager, you will be responsible for the accounts transferred to you for exit purposes.
This includes following up with clients on top up/closure instructions (e.g. Execution of securities and forex transactions to facilitate account closure)

You will:
• act as the primary or secondary point of contact for the clients; manage daily administration, client servicing and attend to compliance requirements
• be the liaison between the various operational sub-teams to ensure smooth account closure
• ensure strict compliance with all internal policies and external regulations and legal guidelines are adhered to
• ensure the occurrence of errors and operational problems are minimized, promptly and properly document any issues that occur

• Offer in-depth coverage of specific credits during periods of market stress, reprioritizing quickly as events unfold.
• Work closely with municipal sales and financial advisors to deliver timely, actionable credit views.
• Respond efficiently to inbound inquiries, balancing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about performing research, analyzing data and coding up improvements to complex algorithmic trading strategies? We're looking for someone to analyze, adapt and improve the quantitative performance of UBS’s suite of agency algorithmic trading and smart order routing strategies.

The successful candidate will primarily:
• perform thorough research on areas such as market microstructure and market impact analysis.
• perform Transaction Costs Analysis (TCA) to minimize executions costs.
• improve consistency of algo performance and reduce outliers and risk, particularly during significant unscheduled as well as scheduled events e.g. index rebalance events.
• design and spec new trading strategies with a particular focus on low latency trading strategies.
• analyze trading patterns and trends within market data (L2 or L3 format).
• employ modern data analytical tools such as machine learning but in a controlled and practical way.
• adapt algorithms to adjust to new markets, venues, order types, asset classes and regulation.
• generate intraday trading signals and volume forecasts from microseconds to minutes.
• communicate with internal stakeholders and external clients and vendors to understand business requirements and market trends.
• produce analytics and reports to monitor and benchmark trading performance both internally and for clients

jobs.title: Investment Advisor
jobs.description:
Your role :
Do you have the perfect pitch? Do you follow the markets, even in your spare time?

We’re looking for an investment advisor to:
• Work closely with the Premium Advisory Specialist team in Taiwan & APAC
• Act as the dedicated portfolio specialist for clients with UBS Advice Premium Mandates, providing comprehensive investment advice across various asset classes, guided by Chief Investment Office's Strategic Asset Allocation and Tactical Asset Allocation
• Deliver customized investment proposals directly to clients to match their investment objectives, risk appetite and preferences
• Perform trade executions and regular systematic portfolio reviews to keep clients' investments on track and identify potential risks
• Provide advice based on UBS investment views (through Chief Investment Office) that aims to maximize the client's portfolio performance while being consistent with the client's objectives
• Monitor client portfolios on a regular basis in close co-operation with the client (with regular reviews of client risk profile and investment objectives)
• Pro-actively contact clients with meaningful portfolio updates and provides investment recommendations within a portfolio context and a disciplined / risk-controlled framework
• Responsible for timely and adequate execution, confirmation and supervision of orders given by the client
• Follow developments in the financial markets to maintain an understanding of both current and anticipated trends across relevant markets and asset classes

jobs.description:
Looking to start your career in a company that encourages learning and professional growth?

As a part of your team, you will
• •Design, develop, and improve the digital products and technology services we provide to our clients and employees.
• •Apply a broad range of software engineering practices, from analyzing user needs and developing new features to automated testing and deployment.
• •Ensure the quality, security, reliability, and compliance of our solutions by applying our digital principles and implementing both functional and non-functional requirements.
• •Build observability into our solutions, monitor production health, help to resolve incidents, and remediate the root cause of risks and issues.
• •Understand, represent, and advocate for client needs.
• •Share knowledge and expertise with colleagues and contribute regularly to our engineering culture and internal communities.

Tech Graduate Program
• You will participate in our immersive global Tech Graduate Program, designed to accelerate your development as a software engineer. The program offers:
• •Hands on experience from day one on real, business critical platforms.
• •Exposure to cutting edge technologies including cloud, containers, and distributed systems.
• •Professional development through structured learning, certifications, and engineering communities.
• •Guidance from experienced engineers and architects who will mentor and support your growth.
• •A collaborative, international environment where you learn from peers across regions.
• •Career advancement through an 18 month comprehensive program starting in August 2026, setting you up for long term success at UBS.

jobs.title: Lead, Institutional Tokenization Origination & Structuring
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about the future of banking through digital transformation and digital assets? Do you see yourself playing an integral part in driving strategic projects and shaping the Group Digital Assets transformation globally?

We are seeking an emerging leader to originate, shape, and drive the execution of institutional tokenization initiatives globally across the firm, in close partnership with Investment Bank (IB), Asset Management (AM), Global Wealth Management (GWM), and Personal & Corporate Banking (P&C). This role sits at the intersection of capital markets, regulation, and blockchain-enabled market infrastructure. It is designed for a “rising star” who can identify and translate strategic opportunities into executable, institutionally viable solutions by mobilizing stakeholders across a complex organization. This is not a standalone business development role and not a tokenization platform/product ownership role. Success depends on credibility, influence, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills, and the ability to deliver outcomes across organizational boundaries.

Key Responsibilities
• originate and shape institutional tokenization opportunities across IB, AM, GWM, and P&C, converting strategic priorities into concrete initiatives with clear divisional sponsorship and measurable outcomes
• drive end-to-end execution of complex tokenization initiatives, including strategic approach, partner selection, delivery planning, and cross-functional coordination across Product, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations, and Distribution/Coverage
• act as a central orchestrator across divisions, aligning stakeholders and maintaining momentum without direct authority, including managing competing priorities and ambiguous problem spaces
• partner closely with internal and external Tokenization Platform Owner/teams (product & infrastructure ownership) to translate institutional requirements into scalable platform capabilities, while maintaining clear decision rights and separation between origination/structuring and platform ownership
• plan and support negotiation of strategic partnerships with key ecosystem participants (e.g., custodians, infrastructure providers, tokenization agents, administrators, exchanges), ensuring commercial, operational, and regulatory viability
• integrate regulatory, governance, and risk considerations into initiative design and execution, ensuring institutionally robust pathways to market across relevant jurisdictions
• establish and improve repeatable execution patterns (governance, templates, workstreams, decision forums, milestones) to increase delivery velocity and transparency across initiatives
• represent the firm credibly in key discussions with internal and external executive stakeholders as required by the initiative (e.g., institutional clients, strategic partners, industry forums), focused on delivery and scalable structures

Additional US Responsibility
• act as a key interface to regional management in the US, ensuring a coherent and executable Digital Assets strategy by aligning global priorities with regional market, regulatory, and client requirements

What Success Looks Like (12–18 months)
• a sponsor-backed portfolio of priority ecosystem initiatives across IB, AM, GWM, and P&C with clear governance, decision rights, and delivery milestones
• progress 2–3 cross-divisional tokenization initiatives from concept through structured delivery planning to executed launch or a defined go-live pathway, depending on complexity and jurisdiction
• a repeatable “institutional tokenization playbook” covering structuring patterns, partner archetypes, risk/compliance pathways, and execution routines
• demonstrable stakeholders pull: divisions proactively bring opportunities because the role accelerates delivery rather than creating friction

jobs.description:
Are you interested in real estate asset management? Are you an expert in quality management and do you have strong analytical skills? Would you like to use your skill set and knowledge to support our local product teams in Switzerland, responsible for managing the real estate investment products in the DACH region?

We’re looking for a quality management specialist to support the real estate investment teams in their daily tasks such as:

• maintenance, modification, and quality assurance of master data, including ongoing validation of monthly data imports provided by external property management companies
• performance of data analyses and KPI monitoring to ensure data accuracy
• preparation, review, and coordination of regular and ad-hoc reports for real estate asset managers in Switzerland
• initiation, coordination and monitoring of operational processes for the Asset Management department
• administration and support of external marketing mandates
• further development and maintenance of the central, CRM-based tenant and concept database, including AI-supported data validation and automated quality checks
• coordination of tenant credit checks and operator risk monitoring, including preliminary analyses to identify patterns and potential early risk indicators
• execution and coordination of Know-Your-Clients (KYC) and third-party checks in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
• support of audit-relevant quality controls, ensuring compliance with documentation, retention, and archiving guidelines
• active participation in real estate asset management projects and collaboration with external partner

jobs.description:
Are you curious about how large global organizations manage technology risk at scale?
Do you enjoy analysing complex problems and turning data into actionable insight?
Are you eager to start your career in a team that safeguards the bank’s stability through modern risk management practices?
If this sounds interesting take your next career step with UBS!

• Contribute to the development and maintenance of risk dashboards, reporting, and governance materials.
• Support automation, tooling enhancements, and AI adoption initiatives impacting technology risk.
• Work with stakeholders to incorporate risk and control requirements into application development backlogs.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about transforming data into a true asset that drives innovation and growth? Do you have the expertise and vision to help shape the future of data management for a leading global asset manager? If so, we want you to join our Chief Data Office (CDO) team as a Senior Product Owner / Lead Business Analyst.

We at UBS Asset Management believe that data is not just information – it’s one of our most valuable assets. Our mission is to establish data as a value driver and enabler of strategic innovation across the firm. We are seeking a driven, forward-thinking individual who can help us build the next generation of data platforms and unlock the potential of AI and GenAI for the future.

Your role:
As a Senior Product Owner / Lead Business Analyst, you will play a key role in building and managing the data foundation of UBS Asset Management, working at the intersection of data, technology, and business.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Managing the Roadmap: Define and prioritize the product roadmap for all applications supporting our data foundation, ensuring alignment with the CDO’s strategic vision.
- Business Analysis: Collaborate with key stakeholders across UBS Asset Management to analyze business requirements, define use cases, and translate them into actionable projects.
- As-Is Process & Data Flow Analysis: Conduct comprehensive assessments of current data flows, processes, and systems to identify opportunities for innovation and efficiency.
- Target Operating Model & Data Architecture Design: Work closely with data engineers and architects to design the target operating model and data architecture that will transform our data management landscape.
- Data Analytics & Insights: Leverage data analytics to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in data, providing insights that drive business decisions and improve data quality.
- Documentation & User Support: Ensure all data systems and processes are well-documented, including process flows, data dictionaries, and user guides. Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and assist end-users during transitions to new platforms.
